verdict.rationale: Semgrep's default local/offline analysis mode keeps code on the user's machine and never uploads it (semgrep-gh-2, probe-7), which inherently prevents that data from feeding any AI training. However, once cloud features like Semgrep Assistant/AI-Powered Detection or the AppSec Platform are used, there's no explicit documentation of a data-training opt-out or privacy policy addressing AI model training.
